title: Punctured degree-111 cyclic components and five repeated coordinates

claims.statement: The product of three three-field degree-111 cyclic codes, each punctured at one anchor parity bit, and the five-coordinate repetition code, with the stated radius-19 adaptive and majority decoder, carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 243746376703386069/500000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=3123857783472802875057418115050 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(50651/500).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), orbit count, nominal tails, field and operation bound (1), auxiliary child tails (2), and weighted admission and occupancy (3).
